text:
maya: heads up — i'm seeing a surge of eval artifacts from quantized bring-ups (q4a-v2) that do NOT include model_provenance metadata. dashboards show 'unknown' under model column :facepalm:
kevin: ugh. do you have an example manifest or object key?
maya: pasted one below — upload manifest from runner v1.9.2 for a quantized run
```
{
  "run_id": "r-2026-03-20-11",
  "model": "q4a-v2-8bit",
  "artifacts": ["s3://eval-artifacts/.../sample-123.jsonl"],
  "metadata": {
    "runner_version": "1.9.2",
    "upload_time": "2026-03-20T11:12:33Z"
    // missing model_provenance, hardware_tag, quant_config
  }
}
```
sara: that looks like the runner's upload enrichment step didn't run. there was a small refactor that moved provenance population into the post-processing plugin — maybe the plugin bails for quantized artifacts because kv-cache is present? :thinking_face
ben: if enrichment is gated on presence of full model weights path, quantized-only runs might skip. quick mitigation: have runner fallback to `model_id` + `quantization_profile` from the job spec when provenance missing. low-risk patch.
kevin: agree. but need to trace back why CI landed the refactor without test coverage. is there a unit test covering manifest enrichment for quantized runs?
sara: not currently — we only assert enrichment for standard runner flows. i'll add a test matrix entry: quantized=true, kv_cache=true.
maya: ops-bot just fired an aggregator alert for this — about 124 artifacts in the last 2 hours flagged as missing_provenance.
ops-bot: ALERT: eval-artifacts-analyzer detected 124 missing_provenance events in prod-us-west-2 (severity: medium). first_seen: 2026-03-20T11:10:02Z.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/847 — "runner: fallback populate model_provenance for quantized runs" by @sara. includes unit test and integration fixture.
ben: can we also add a short-term ingestion-side patch in the artifact-indexer to map `unknown` -> best-effort model from s3 key naming? that would avoid dashboard noise until runner patch rolls out.
kevin: sure, but we'd need to tag that mapping so it's auditable — don't want silent mismatches for billing. add `provenance_inferred_by: indexer-v1` and `provenance_inferred_reason` in the document.
maya: temporary cli workaround for devs generating local quant runs: add `--provenance "model=q4a-v2,quant=q4a-8bit,commit=abcd123"` to `eval-runner upload-manifest` command.
kevin: can someone grep the last 7 days to estimate scope beyond the 124? i'll run a query after lunch.
sara: i'll push the tests and the PR patching runner tonight. plan: ship small patch to dedicated staging, run smoke against eval-indexer, then prod deploy tomorrow morning with canary. :shipit:
ben: also add a dashboard alert that percent_missing_provenance > 0.5% triggers an oncall page. we only had an ops-bot alert, but it's noisy; need a human escalation path.
maya: perfect. thanks all. tagging @kevin for follow-up on cost/billing mapping. :eyes:
kevin: got it, will follow up with a short postmortem once we have deploy and indexer remap results.
ci-bot: build 4028 for runtime passed in staging; integration tests for manifest enrichment succeeded.
sara: landing PR now. will coordinate deploy times in #eng-release.
maya: closing the loop — created a tiny playbook in /wiki/eval-provenance-incident with mitigation steps and commands.
